reports.desc: The website uses bogus US physical address and is actually registered to China. They also use stolen images of models/products from actual legitimate stores (such as Retrofete), and are advertising items they do not have. A shipping label will be created, but the item will never ship. Customer service will run you in circles. They are also affiliated with wearforesthub.com so steer clear of that one too.

Auntie Rue marketing claims to sell genuine titanium cutting boards appearing to be approximately 1/4 of an inch thick in the advertisements. The products received are a thickness of .035 inches composed of an unknown alloy of stainless steel. This was personally verified by me through the use of XRF elemental composition technology. The seller maintains marketing that denigrates other sellers of the very cheap knock offs that they delivered to me. The seller then denies the reality of all evidence that I have presented to them through technological means and physical analyzation that is passed to them via emails by me. It is obvious that the only contact to the company is an AI entity posing as a first name of (Sarah)
Imperial left voice mail: This is Imperial contacting you with an important business matter. Press 1 to be connected or dial 855-762-5665. This message is intended for name withheld.

I bought a Fish tank and Stand combo. I received the product and set it up. As soon as I filled it with water it leaked and poured all over my homes floor.  I contacted the company to allow me to pay and send it back to them and asked many times for the return shipping address they completely ignored my request to do so. Finally I got a response that quoted if you where to return it to us we we gladly refund you $6.00.!!!!!
Subscription service that I canceled and they still charged me and I cannot get into contact with anybody.

The sale ended up going thru a platform called SHOP where they tell you your order shipped and use some company called 17TRACK which i have had problems with before - even though this company is in Canada - they show it shipped from China and eventually show it delivered to my employer which NEVER happened and they have never ever answered not one of my 25 or so emails and the phone number does not work and the platform that takes the order says they cannot control what the seller does !  It is not alot of money but it is the principle and i am a senior citizen so to me $10 is alot of money and could have bought a different gift.  They do not even answer messages through their facebook site so they are just a fake storefront taking money.
The message read - Hey Anthony, Inoticed an update showing you had up to 250K,.What's the best email to send it to before it closes out?

Saw an advertisement on line and ordered clothing items.  Eventually received a delivery tracking number.  When it said that it had been delivered didn't see anything.  Reached out on the inquiries@delarira.com address and spoke with someone who said they would resend the items once everything was reprocessed.  Nothing has happened since.  Just sent them an email today asking for a status update and am realizing now that I must have been scammed.

Ordered a reborn doll from reborndollsshop.com. Received a plastic baby doll that looks nothing like what was advertised. The baby came in a box from babeside.com, even though I ordered through reborndollsshop.com. Contacted both businesses. Babeside responded, but reborndollsshop has not. Attempted to use their live chat feature, but it is never working. Very frustrating to spend so much money only to receive a cheap doll that I could have bought at a local store.

I purchased the items in July they refunded my money. Then They tried to debit my card November 13, and the bank declined. They called me said I had a subscription, I didn’t, said I owed 200. I said no I don’t have a subscription then they said they would keep billing me monthly. They would not cancel unless I paid 143.00. My bank advised me to settle. So I said ok. Gave them my card info he said wait. Then came back and said everything processed and my subscription was cancelled.
I asked for confirmation of the debit. 383.00! I said I did not agree to that amount. I called my bank and they said it’s not fraud because you agreed to 143 dollars. I said, yeah, but they charged me $383. How is that not fraud. So now I have to wait until it posts to my account and then dispute the charge. Save yourself the aggravation. do not buy cardio flush under any circumstances. The product is garbage and the customer service is a scam.

Placed an order and almost immediately (within 15 mins.) I realized the site was questionable because of lack of readable reviews and no serviceable phone number for customer service, only a email listed. I emailed them and requested the order be cancelled, multiple times. I got one AI generated response which promised someone would contact me with 48 hrs. No acknowledgment of cancellation. Shortly thereafter, around 15 mins, a email came saying the order was shipped. I have since seen a lot of information on line that leads me to believe this company is ripping people off and should be shut down.
